peer_identity.arc_label: Aging cold mercenary Aghnar who accepts genocide contract, duels Steelhead, dies by mini-bomb
peer_identity.honcho_notes: Emotionally cold, transactional mercenary. Adheres to warrior honor code—denounces dishonorable tactics as treason. Aging; notices own deterioration. Accepted Pthagurean genocide contract for payment. Won the Steelhead duel (Steelhead yielded honorably) before Steelhead's treachery cost him Honorata/Oda. Chose mutual mini-bomb suicide rather than capitulate. Final voice: sharp moral indignation ('bio-rat,' 'traitor').
peer_identity.rationale: By vol10, Aghnar has aged visibly, publicly broke with the Empire (killing guards on departure), accepted a Pthagurean genocide contract, and is described as 'colder than a Venusian salmon's blood.' This is a dramatic shift from the vol06–08 warrior who wanted to retire and build family life. Vol11 shows his final combat against Steelhead and suicide by mini-bomb with Honorata/Oda after Steelhead's treachery. The emotionally cold mercenary voice cannot share a card with the emotionally invested revenge-warrior.
